answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 157098 Country: India Title: I am a Sunni boy and follow Hanafi school of jurisprudence. I want to merry my father's sister's daughter (phuphi ki beti). Is it permissible? Question: I am a Sunni boy and follow Hanafi school of jurisprudence. I want to merry my father's sister's daughter (phuphi ki beti). Is it permissible? Answer ID: 157098 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 318/271/D=3/1439) Yes, it is lawful to marry the daughter of your father’s sister (phuphi). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
